issue.title: Support azure-datalake-store 1.x in the Microsoft Azure provider
issue.body:
The Microsoft Azure provider caps `azure-datalake-store<1`. `azure-datalake-store` 1.0.1 removed the `lib.auth` API that `AzureDataLakeHook.get_conn()` calls (`providers/microsoft/azure/src/airflow/providers/microsoft/azure/hooks/data_lake.py`). With 1.x installed, creating the Data Lake Gen1 connection with a tenant/secret fails. Every `TestAzureDataLakeHook` test also fails with `AttributeError: Mock object has no attribute 'auth'`, which is what kept the scheduled CI upgrade (#73629) red.

The cap was added in the CI upgrade PR to unblock it. Neither the CI upgrade (`breeze ci upgrade`) nor the automatic dependency floor bump will lift it on their own.

**To do**
- Port `AzureDataLakeHook.get_conn()` to the credential API that `azure-datalake-store` 1.x provides.
- Update the `TestAzureDataLakeHook` mocks to match.
- Decide whether to keep 0.0.x working or raise the floor to `>=1`. A floor raise is a breaking change for the provider and needs a changelog entry.

**Done when**
- The `<1` cap and its comment are removed from `providers/microsoft/azure/pyproject.toml`.
- The `azure-datalake-store` entry is removed from `[tool.airflow.dependency-floors.exclude]` in the root `pyproject.toml`.
- The azure provider tests pass on 1.x, including LowestDeps.

---
Drafted-by: Claude Code (Opus 5); reviewed by @potiuk before posting

comments.body:
